Questions? We Have Answers. Subheadline: Find quick answers to the most common questions about DAYRADE, tournaments, and how to get started.

**Category 1: Getting Started** Q: How do I create an account? A: Click "Sign Up Now" and follow the onboarding flow. You'll create your spirit animal, build your profile card, and be ready to compete in under 2 minutes. Q: Is DAYRADE free? A: Registration is free. The Elevator Division is free to enter. Crusader and Raider divisions require tickets, which can be purchased or earned through rewards. Q: What is KYC and why is it required? A: KYC (Know Your Customer) is a verification process that ensures fair play by preventing multiple accounts. It's required to compete in tournaments and withdraw winnings.

**Category 2: Tournaments** Q: How do tournaments work? A: Tournaments are time-bound competitions where all participants start with the same virtual capital. Your performance determines your rank. Top performers win prizes. Q: What are the different divisions? A: Elevator (beginners, free entry), Crusader (intermediate, low-cost tickets, up to $1,000 prizes), and Raider (advanced, premium tickets, up to $10,000 prizes). Q: How do I enter a tournament? A: Browse the schedule, select a tournament, and register with a ticket. You'll receive access to your tournament trading account when the event begins.

**Category 3: Rewards & Prizes** Q: How do I earn reward points? A: Complete daily lessons, refer new users, and participate in community events. Points can be redeemed for free tournament tickets. Q: How do I withdraw my winnings? A: Cash prizes are credited to your account within 24 hours of tournament completion. You can withdraw to your bank account or crypto wallet from your dashboard. Q: What is user status? A: User status is a progression system that unlocks perks like early tournament access, exclusive community channels, and priority support.

**Category 4: Safety & Security** Q: Is my data safe? A: Yes. We use 256-bit encryption and comply with international data protection standards. Your information is never sold or shared. Q: How do you prevent cheating? A: Our anti-cheat system monitors all activity in real-time. KYC ensures one account per person, and suspicious behavior is flagged immediately.
